title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-ow1e.208: test does not compile - wrong call signatures for protect_request and unprotect_request
description:
Commit 1444000dc adds test `wrong_key_does_not_poison_replay_window` that calls:

1. `protect_request(0x02, &[], b"fake")` — but the actual API requires output buffers: `protect_request(code, options, payload, ct_out: &mut [u8], opt_out: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(usize, usize)>`. Missing `ct_out` and `opt_out` args.

2. `unprotect_request(&attacker_option, &attacker_ciphertext)` — but the actual API requires `unprotect_request(oscore_option, ciphertext, options_out: &mut [u8], payload_out: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(u8, usize, usize)>`. Missing `options_out` and `payload_out` args.

Both calls will fail to compile. The test was never verified with `cargo test` before commit.

Affected file: rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs
